(async () => { const t0 = performance.now(); while (!game.scene.isActive('Boss') && performance.now() - t0 < 12000) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50)); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); return game.scene.isActive('Boss') ? 'Boss scene active' : 'NOT in boss'; })()

(async () => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Boss'); s.player.invulnUntil = Infinity; s.throwItem(); const it = s.items.getChildren()[s.items.getChildren().length - 1]; it.setVelocity(0, 0); it.setAngularVelocity(0); s.player.setPosition(500, GROUND_Y - 30); s.player.facing = 1; it.setPosition(530, GROUND_Y - 30); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50)); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {keyCode: 74, code: 'KeyJ', key: 'j'})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 60)); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {keyCode: 74, code: 'KeyJ', key: 'j'})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 30)); return JSON.stringify({reflected: it.reflected, vx: Math.round(it.body.velocity.x), vy: Math.round(it.body.velocity.y)}); })()

(async () => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Boss'); const t0 = performance.now(); while (s.bossHp === 5 && performance.now() - t0 < 4000) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 20)); return JSON.stringify({bossHpAfterReflect: s.bossHp, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0)}); })()

(async () => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Boss'); s.player.invulnUntil = Infinity; s.bossHp = 1; s.throwItem(); const it = s.items.getChildren()[s.items.getChildren().length - 1]; s.reflect(it); const t1 = performance.now(); while (!s.over && performance.now() - t1 < 4000) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 20)); return JSON.stringify({over: s.over, bossHp: s.bossHp, playerHp: s.player.hp}); })()
